cues.f: start + round(16 * fps / 30) + round(hold * fps / 30) + i * (round(12 * fps / 30) + round(hold * fps / 30))
cues.repeat: max(0, min(5, floor((frames - start - round(16 * fps / 30) - round(hold * fps / 30) - round(12 * fps / 30)) / (round(12 * fps / 30) + round(hold * fps / 30))) + 1))
cues.what: the wheel rolls one item (5 rolls; fewer when the video ends sooner)
